# The ARTIFACT diagnostic code register — the codes `whip verify` and the
# report validators refuse a construct_graph or lowered_ir artifact with.
# GENERATED by scripts/regen-diagnostic-codes.sh from the string literals
# under construct_graph. and lowered_ir. in the shipped sources; do not
# hand-edit.
#
# Registered by SHAPE (DR-0107). A <placeholder> is a slot the artifact fills
# -- an owner kind, a field name -- and stays a placeholder here, so the
# ledger is finite. Anything after a ':' in an emitted spelling is a LOCATOR
# naming which object, and is not part of the code.
#
# Second column: COVERED when a test source names the shape, PROVISIONAL
# when none does. The refusal fixtures under the CLI's main_tests are the
# corpus; a COVERED shape is frozen under the append-only guarantee, a
# PROVISIONAL one may still be corrected.
